pois.name: Azzurra
pois.description: Azzurra, sail number I-4 is an international 12 m Class boat designed by the Vallicelli studio.
pois.intro: Azzurra is a yacht racing team that competed in the America's Cup, the Audi MedCup and the 52 Super Series for the Italian Yacht Club Costa Smeralda.

pois.name: Faro di Capo Ferro
pois.intro: Capo Ferro Lighthouse is an active lighthouse located on the same name promontory which marks the southern entrance to the Strait of Bonifacio and to the Maddalena archipelago, in the municipality of Arzachena, in the north east of Sardinia, Italy, on the Tyrrhenian Sea.

pois.name: Faro dell'Isola delle Bisce
pois.intro: Isola delle Bisce Lighthouse is an active lighthouse located on a small islet, 590 metres from Capo Ferro Lighthouse, which make part of the Maddalena archipelago in the Strait of Bonifacio. The lighthouse guides the ships through the narrow Canale delle Bisce; the structure is situated in the municipality of Arzachena on the Tyrrhenian Sea.
